record.paper_title: Some Open Problems Concerning Orthogonal Polynomials on Fractals and Related Questions
record.original_question: Given a modulus of continuity ω, find a compact set K such that the Green function g_{C\K} itself has two-sided pointwise bounds controlled by ω in terms of the distance to K. Specifically, for δ = dist(z, K) small enough, determine K so that there exist constants C1, C2 > 0 and δ0 > 0 with C1 ω(δ) ≤ g_{C\K}(z) ≤ C2 ω(δ) whenever δ ≤ δ0, uniformly in z.

evidence.quote: Problem 2. Given modulus of continuity ω, find a compact set K such that C1ω(δ) ≤ g_{C\K}(z) ≤ C2ω(δ) for δ = dist(z, K) ≤ δ0, where C1, C1 and δ0 do not depend on z.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $\omega:[0,\infty)	o[0,\infty)$ be a modulus of continuity, i.e.\ a non-decreasing, subadditive function with $\omega(0)=0$ and $\omega$ continuous at $0$. For a non-polar compact set $K\subset\mathbb{C}$, let $g_{\mathbb{C}\setminus K}(z)$ denote the Green function of the unbounded component of $\mathbb{C}\setminus K$ with logarithmic pole at $\infty$, extended by $0$ on $K$. For $z\in\mathbb{C}\setminus K$, write $\delta(z):=\operatorname{dist}(z,K)$.

Problem. Given $\omega$ as above, construct a non-polar compact set $K\subset\mathbb{C}$ and find constants $C_1,C_2>0$ and $\delta_0>0$ (independent of $z$) such that the two-sided pointwise estimate
$$C_1\,\omega(\delta(z))\;\le\; g_{\mathbb{C}\setminus K}(z)\;\le\; C_2\,\omega(\delta(z))$$
holds for every $z$ with $\delta(z)\le\delta_0$.
artifact.status_search_result: Closely related work by Goncharov and collaborators establishes upper bounds and one-sided smoothness estimates of Green functions for complements of rarefied Cantor-type sets in terms of moduli of continuity. However, no source found in the search provides a general construction yielding two-sided pointwise bounds $C_1\omega(\delta)\le g\le C_2\omega(\delta)$ for an arbitrary prescribed modulus of continuity $\omega$. The problem appears to remain open in the general form posed.

status_evidence.title: On Smoothness of the Green Function for the Complement of a Rarefied Cantor-Type Set
status_evidence.snippet: Smoothness of the Green functions for the complement of rarefied Cantor-type sets is described in terms of moduli of continuity such as 1/log(1/δ).
status_evidence.claim: Partial results give one-sided modulus-of-continuity estimates for Green functions of Cantor-type complements, but not the general two-sided construction for arbitrary ω.

status_evidence.title: Hölder continuity of Green's functions
status_evidence.snippet: Studies Hölder regularity of Green's functions g_{C\E} for compact sets E in the plane.
status_evidence.claim: Hölder-type (power) moduli are addressed; general moduli of continuity with two-sided pointwise bounds are not provided.
